grammarFocus: 比较级；最高级；方式与时间介词；how long / how often。
title: A New Bus Route in My City
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和问题都是模拟材料，不是官方雅思考试。请仔细阅读短文，根据短文内容选择或填写答案。填空题的答案必须与短文中的词完全一致，且不超过字数限制。
passage: My name is Li Hua. I live in a small city in China. Last year, the city started a new bus route. The route is called Bus 15. It goes from the train station to the university. Before Bus 15, I took Bus 8 to work. Bus 8 was slow and often late. Now I take Bus 15. It is faster and cleaner than Bus 8. The bus comes every 10 minutes. In the morning, many students take Bus 15. The bus is usually full at 8 a.m. In the evening, it is less crowded. I usually take the bus at 7:30 a.m. and return home at 6 p.m. The journey takes about 25 minutes. Before, my journey was 40 minutes. Now I have more time to read in the morning. The bus stop is near my home. It is only a 5-minute walk. My friend Wang Wei takes Bus 15 too. He works at the university. He says the bus is the best way to travel in our city. Sometimes, on weekends, I take Bus 15 to the city center. The city center is busier than my neighborhood. There are many shops and restaurants. I like to go there with my family. We usually go by bus because parking is difficult. The bus is cheaper than driving. A ticket costs 2 yuan. Driving a car costs more. I think Bus 15 is a great improvement for our city. It is one of the most popular bus routes now.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the new bus route?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段提到“The route is called Bus 15.”，所以新公交路线是15路。
短文中说“The bus comes every 10 minutes.”，所以是每10分钟一班。

questions.prompt: How long does the journey take now?
questions.explanation: 短文中说“The journey takes about 25 minutes.”，所以现在路程大约25分钟。

questions.prompt: How long was the journey before?
questions.explanation: 短文中说“Before, my journey was 40 minutes.”，所以以前是40分钟。

questions.prompt: How does Wang Wei describe the bus?
questions.explanation: 短文中Wang Wei说“the bus is the best way to travel in our city.”，所以他认为公交是最好的方式。
questions.evidence: He says the bus is the best way to travel in our city.

questions.prompt: Why does the family usually go by bus to the city center?
options: Because they don't have a car
questions.explanation: 短文中说“We usually go by bus because parking is difficult.”，所以因为停车困难。
questions.evidence: We usually go by bus because parking is difficult.

questions.prompt: How much does a bus ticket cost? (Write one number and one word.)
questions.explanation: 短文中说“A ticket costs 2 yuan.”，所以票价是2元。

questions.prompt: How long does it take to walk to the bus stop? (Write one number and one word.)
questions.explanation: 短文中说“It is only a 5-minute walk.”，所以步行到车站需要5分钟。

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Bus 15 is more crowded in the evening than in the morning.
questions.explanation: 短文说“In the evening, it is less crowded.”，即晚上更不拥挤，所以题目说晚上更拥挤是错误的。
questions.evidence: In the evening, it is less crowded.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Li Hua's friend Wang Wei works at the university.
questions.explanation: 短文中明确说“He works at the university.”，所以王伟在大学工作是真实的。

vocabulary.example: The bus is usually full at 8 a.m.

grammar.title: 比较级、最高级、方式与时间介词、how long / how often
grammar.explanation: 比较级用于比较两个事物，常加 -er 或 more，如 faster than；最高级用于三个或以上事物中最突出的，常加 -est 或 most，如 the best way；方式介词 by 表示交通方式，如 by bus；时间介词 at 用于具体时间点，如 at 7:30 a.m.；how long 问时间长度，how often 问频率。
grammar.example: It is faster and cleaner than Bus 8.

options: Bus 15 is more fast than Bus 8.
questions.explanation: 比较级 faster 用于两者比较，后面用 than。
questions.evidence: It is faster and cleaner than Bus 8.

options: He says the bus is the best way to travel.
He says the bus is best way to travel.
He says the bus is the better way to travel.
He says the bus is good way to travel.
answers: He says the bus is the best way to travel.
questions.explanation: 最高级 the best 用于三者以上比较，前面要加 the。
questions.evidence: He says the bus is the best way to travel in our city.

options: I usually take the bus at 7:30 a.m.
I usually take the bus on 7:30 a.m.
I usually take the bus in 7:30 a.m.
I usually take the bus by 7:30 a.m.
answers: I usually take the bus at 7:30 a.m.
questions.explanation: 具体时间点前用介词 at。
questions.evidence: I usually take the bus at 7:30 a.m. and return home at 6 p.m.

answers: How often does the bus come?
